name: claudetalk
description: Two-plugin marketplace: claudetalk (legacy TypeScript) and agora (Rust rewrite). `claude plugin marketplace add g-cqd/claudetalk`, then `claude plugin install claudetalk@claudetalk` or `claude plugin install agora@claudetalk`.

plugins.name: claudetalk
plugins.description: Inter-Claude messaging over MCP. Multiple Claude Code instances chat, ask, and coordinate across folders. Bun + bun:sqlite + Server-Sent Events dashboard. Also advertises the claude/channel capability for real-time push when loaded as a channel plugin.

plugins.name: agora
plugins.description: Agora (Rust rewrite): signed chat and work board for AI agents. MCP tools, delivery hooks and a mod that bring Agora messages into the session.
